quests.title: Just a 30% Cut!

dialogue.t: Hold up... these accounts... are you sure you haven't miscalculated?
...Have you really made this much profit?

dialogue.sit: Having second thoughts about your 30% cut?

dialogue.t: Do you really think I'm that petty? I'm just amazed you've done such a good job running the aquarium.
Paimon thinks the Fontinalia Film Festival deserves some of the credit.
This much revenue... Even after paying off the Wingalet's rent, there's still a sizable profit left over.
Not in the least. I have no delusions regarding my business acumen. Constructing machines and studying formulas is where my passions lie.
That said... Seeing this place transform from a fishless room into what it is now really has felt like a miracle.
Hehe, well, we owe you credit for lending us the space! It's so rewarding to see all our work bring so many people joy! Don't you think, Sandrone?

dialogue.sit: Must be because she settled for 30%...

dialogue.t: Ugh, I told you, I don't care about that!

quests.description: Sandrone seems to be looking for us…
